label: Rotating y
source: Aidan Burns, The Highgate Collection: 2017 expanded PDF printed p. 293 / PDF p. 294; 2014 PDF printed p. 211 / PDF p. 212.
notation: Four-count pass cycle: Anne→Daniel, Daniel→Ben, Ben→Clare, Clare→Anne; each juggler self-throws between passes.
notes: The prose identifies each pass recipient and says everyone passes four count. modelLimits: This graph encodes the four-count causal cycle, not the jugglers’ spatial paths around the y formation.

label: Rotating λ
source: Aidan Burns, The Highgate Collection: 2017 expanded PDF printed p. 294 / PDF p. 295; 2014 PDF printed p. 212 / PDF p. 213.
notation: Australian rotating-y variation. Everyone passes four count; Daniel walks clockwise around the outside while Anne, Ben, and Clare walk anticlockwise inside. The diagram is transcribed as three repeated pass phases plus the visible continuation; walking direction stays in notation.
notes: The source causal diagram has four alternating-hand rows with 13 visible event nodes per row; the last node illustrates the repeated first phase, so the cycle has 12 events per row. Pass links occur at the repeated four-event phases; interleaved horizontal links are self throws.
variants: Rotating y is the related pattern, not an alias.
modelLimits: The causal graph records throw destinations and event order. The clockwise outside path and anticlockwise inside paths are retained as notation.

label: Cyclone
source: Aidan Burns, The Highgate Collection: 2017 expanded PDF printed p. 291 / PDF p. 292; 2014 PDF printed p. 209 / PDF p. 210.
notation: Four-person mixed-count pattern. Anne faces Clare and Ben faces Daniel in the initial parallelogram. Anne/Daniel walk anticlockwise around one oval, Ben/Clare clockwise around another. Pass to the facing person in the parallelogram; while moving into an oval pass on two count, alternating with the other person on that oval; at the oval edge pass on four count.
notes: The source causal diagram has alternating R/L event lanes. It displays the repeated first event at the right boundary; the serialized cycle contains the preceding 16 events per lane. Cross-lane edges follow the diagram; horizontal links are self throws. The formation and oval travel are retained in the notation.
variants: The source notes that omitting the two-count throws produces a pattern essentially the same as the Minuet (square dance).
modelLimits: The graph records causal event links, not the parallelogram/oval geometry or walking direction.

label: Seattle shuffle
source: Aidan Burns, The Highgate Collection: 2017 expanded PDF printed p. 292 / PDF p. 293; 2014 PDF printed p. 210 / PDF p. 211.
notation: Mixed-count pattern beginning in a rectangle: Anne faces Ben and Clare faces Daniel. Throw to the person in front; after the first pass, the jugglers walk left and pass diagonally opposite, then return to the rectangle. The book says the shown diagram is not the whole pattern and the last diagram returns to the first with Anne/Clare and Ben/Daniel roles switched.
notes: The diagram shows 16 events per person plus the next boundary event. To represent the source-stated role switch as a periodic graph, the displayed half is repeated with Anne/Clare and Ben/Daniel roles swapped. Pass links are transcribed from the diagram; intervening horizontal links are self throws.
variants: The source suggests combining this pattern with Aidan’s feast.
modelLimits: Walking direction and rectangle/diagonal formation are retained in notation. The cycle is expanded to include the stated role-switch transition.
